BOOK ONE · LESSON 127

A famous actress 著名的女演员

著名的女演员

A dialogue between Kate and Liz, who recognize a famous actress (Karen Marsh) and an actor (Conrad Reeves) at a restaurant. They discuss whether the man is her third, fourth or fifth husband, and note that Karen looks old for her age (twenty-nine but must be at least forty). Liz reveals she is not more than twenty-nine herself. The lesson introduces the words famous, actress, actor, read and at least, and the grammar of 'must be' (deduction) and 'can't be' (negative deduction).

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape then answer this question. Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear? 听录音，然后回答问题。谁只有29岁？为什么这件事如此含糊不清？

听录音，然后回答问题。谁只有29岁？为什么这件事如此含糊不清？

  1. 1

    KATE

    Can you recognize that woman, Liz?

    莉兹，你能认出那个女人吗？

  2. 2

    LIZ

    I think I can, Kate. It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.

    我想我认得出来，凯特。那一定是女演员卡伦·马什。

  3. 3

    KATE

    I thought so. Who's that beside her?

    我也这样想。她旁边的那个人是谁？

  4. 4

    LIZ

    That must be Conrad Reeves.

    那一定是康拉德·里弗斯。

  5. 5

    KATE

    Conrad Reeves, the actor? It can't be. Let me have another look. I think you're right! Isn't he her third husband?

    康拉德·里弗斯，那个男演员吗？不可能是。让我再看一看。我想你是对的！他不是她的第3个丈夫吗？

  6. 6

    LIZ

    No. He must be her fourth or fifth.

    不。他一定是她的第4个或第5个丈夫。

  7. 7

    KATE

    Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!

    卡伦·马什看上去不显老嘛！

  8. 8

    LIZ

    She does, doesn't she! I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.

    是的，谁说不是呢！我从报上看到她是29岁，但她一定至少有40岁了。

  9. 9

    KATE

    I'm sure she is.

    我肯定她有40岁了。

  10. 10

    LIZ

    She was a famous actress when I was still at school.

    当我还是学生时，她就是个著名的演员了。

  11. 11

    KATE

    That was a long time ago, wasn't it?

    那是好久以前的事了，是吗？

  12. 12

    LIZ

    Not that long ago! I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.

    不。没有那么久。我自己现在还没29岁呢。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

famous /'feɪməs/
adj. 著名的
actress /'æktrɪs/
n. 女演员
at least /æt liːst/
phr. 至少
actor /'æktə/
n. 男演员
read /riːd/ (read /red/, read)
v. 通过阅读得知

Notes on the text 课文注释

1. must be / can't be

must be 是英文中用来表示根据事实所作的推论，往往译为「一定」。must be 的否定式是 can't be，如 Kate 的话「It can't be.」是对 Liz 的推论（「That must be Conrad Reeves.」）的否定。同时，请注意这里的 can't be（表示不可能）和第45课中 I can't type this letter.（表示能力）的区别。

2. Who's that beside her?

本句中 that 指人。

3. her fourth or fifth

her fourth or fifth 后面省略了 husband。

4. Not that long ago!

句中的 that 是副词、指像 Kate 所说的「那么」遥远，可译作「那样」、「那么」。课文中用斜体印刷表示一种强调，显然 Liz 对 Kate 的判断和对她本人年龄的估算很不满意。
